mil3.7.14:1.2: Bhante Nāgasena, sakkā sabbaṃ sukhumaṃ chinditun-ti. -
mil3.7.14:1.3: Āma mahārāja, sakkā sabbaṃ sukhumaṃ chinditun-ti. -
mil3.7.14:1.5: Dhammo kho mahārāja sabbasukhumo, na kho mahārāja dhammā sabbe sukhumā, sukhuman-ti vā thūlan-ti vā mahārāja dhammānam-etam-adhivacanaṃ,
mil3.7.14:1.6: yaṃ kiñci chinditabbaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ paññāya chindati, na-tthi dutiyaṃ paññāya chedanan-ti. -
